system.description:
Just when you think you've bested a mighty Orc, you've merely succeeded in rousing their anger. Engaging in combat with an Orc is no endeavor for the weak-willed. While others may cower before death's approach, Orcs boldly defy its grasp.

Relentless

When you would drop to 0 HP, you may set your HP to LVL instead, 1/Safe Rest.

+1 Might. [A]

You know Goblin if your INT is not negative (but you call it Orcish, of course). [M]

Orcish Kin: Stormkin — Your blood roils with the coastal storms, the jungle monsoons, and the powerful lightning.

Stormstep

(1/encounter) Reaction (when hit from range): Move up to your Speed towards the attacker. [M]

Nim+ Volume I ancestry variant (LewisH, Santuric). Variants replace the base ancestry: pick this instead of the standard version. Note: variants make your hero stronger than normal.
